title: Load the board once per command; make single-issue reads read one file
description:
Problem: on this repo's own 1,011-issue board, plain 'kbs list' takes 65 s (0.08 s with --no-hooks --no-guidance). Cause: after listing, guidance runs for every printed issue, and collect_guidance_for_issue (rust/src/policy_guidance.rs:33-71; python/src/kanbus/policy_guidance.py:43) reloads the policy files, the configuration and every issue in the directory for each one, so cost is quadratic in board size. Underneath, every single-issue read rebuilds a whole Virtuus table with five GSIs from the directory (rust/src/issue_files.rs:13-38, 164-195; python/src/kanbus/issue_files.py:27-40, 142-156). The same root makes 'ready' (dependencies.rs:277-290), 'dep add' (dependencies.rs:335-351), 'dep tree' (dependency_tree.rs:75-87), 'update --type' (issue_update.rs:226-243), 'show' (console_snapshot.py:262-271) and overlay reconcile quadratic, beyond the already-filed quadratic 'create' (kbs-98e5d0). None of the GSIs is ever queried, and the blocked_by GSI path references 'dependency_type' while the serialized field is 'type', so it indexes nothing.

Work, in both runtimes:
1. Pass the already-loaded issue list and configuration into guidance evaluation instead of reloading per issue; skip guidance entirely for read-only listing commands (list, show, ready, now, stats).
2. Make read_issue_from_file a plain read-and-parse of one file, and write_issue_to_file a temp-file-and-rename write (Virtuus already does that internally). Keep Virtuus, if at all, for the long-lived daemon and console.
3. Where a command needs all issues, load the directory once and pass the collection down (find_duplicate_title, build_dependency_graph, child scans).

Acceptance: 'kbs list' on the Kanbus board under 0.5 s with guidance on; 'kbs create' under 0.3 s with validation on; strace of 'kbs list' shows each issue file opened at most once; existing Gherkin suites pass in both runtimes.
